stages.reference: Create a close visual reference for the living side surface of a mature desert cactus in a harsh grounded dark-fantasy world. The skin should feel thick, waxy and water-conserving, organized into subtle vertical ribs with tough fibrous tissue beneath. Age produces muted scars, dusty abrasion and slight color variation between exposed and recessed areas. Sparse spine bases may inform the material character without turning the study into a botanical illustration. Favor restrained sage, olive and dusty green. Avoid glossy cucumber skin, tropical saturation, giant thorns, decorative flowers or reptile scales. Establish a resilient succulent surface shaped by drought and abrasive wind.
